title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the streets and corridors surrounding Bellarmine University, from the eclectic Highlands to the quiet parks and student-frequented coffee shops just steps from the gates.

cards.title: Sunergos Coffee
cards.subtitle: Norris Place
cards.notes: Walk two blocks from campus to this local favorite for a cold brew or latte. It is a common spot for students to study or hold professional meetings in a welcoming environment.
cards.short_summary: A popular student coffee shop located just two blocks from the Bellarmine campus on Norris Place.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunergos Coffee is located only two blocks from campus on Norris Place and is a very common place for Bellarmine students to visit for coffee and studying.
cards.source_title: Sunergos: A Big Hit at Bellarmine - Knights Media Network
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:30 AM to 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Joe Creason Park
cards.subtitle: Newburg Road
cards.notes: Cross Newburg Road to access 68 acres of green space. Use the paved multi-use path that connects the university property directly to the park's tennis center and trails.
cards.short_summary: A 68-acre public park located directly across Newburg Road from Bellarmine University, featuring a connecting multi-use path.
cards.evidence_claim: Joe Creason Park is right across the street from Bellarmine and includes a paved multi-use path system that connects the university property with the park.
cards.source_title: Bellarmine University connected with Joe Creason Park in new multi-use recreational path project
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk; the connecting path is accessible during daylight hours.

cards.title: Baxter Avenue Theatres
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this cinema in Mid-City Mall for independent and foreign films. Show your Bellarmine ID to receive a discounted student ticket for a movie night with friends.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing cinema in the Highlands offering student discounts and a mix of mainstream and independent films.
cards.evidence_claim: Baxter Avenue Theatres offers discounted student tickets for $8.50 and is a popular destination for Bellarmine students in the Highlands.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Located inside Mid-City Mall; check website for daily showtimes.

cards.title: The Great Escape
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road
cards.notes: Browse a massive selection of comic books, vinyl records, and collectibles. This Highlands staple is a frequent stop for students looking for unique media and pop culture items.
cards.short_summary: An iconic Highlands shop specializing in comics, music, and collectibles, popular with the local student community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Escape is a staple of the Highlands known for its variety of music, comics, and collectibles, making it a fun pit stop for students.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check store for specific hours.

cards.title: Vintage Banana
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road
cards.notes: Find this 'hole in the wall' shop at the end of an alleyway for retro clothing. It is a go-to for students seeking sustainable fashion and one-of-a-kind vintage pieces.
cards.short_summary: A hidden vintage clothing store in the Highlands known for its retro styles and sustainable shopping options.
cards.evidence_claim: Vintage Banana is a retro clothing store found at the end of an alleyway in the Highlands, frequently visited by Bellarmine students for sustainable fashion.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Look for the kitschy banana sign on the street to find the alley entrance.

cards.title: Cherokee Park
cards.subtitle: Eastern Parkway
cards.notes: Head a few blocks northeast to explore this 400-acre park. Walk or bike the 2.3-mile Scenic Loop for a quick escape into nature designed by Frederick Law Olmsted.
cards.short_summary: A major 400-acre public park near campus featuring a famous scenic loop and extensive recreational trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Cherokee Park is a 400-acre park designed by Frederick Law Olmsted located a few blocks northeast of Bardstown Road, near the Bellarmine campus.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Douglass Loop
cards.subtitle: Bardstown Road
cards.notes: Visit this historic trolley turnaround area for the seasonal farmers market. It serves as a community hub with local eateries and shops within walking distance of student housing.
cards.short_summary: A historic commercial node on Bardstown Road featuring a popular farmers market and local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Douglass Loop is a featured Highlands experience for Bellarmine students, specifically noted for its Farmers Market.
cards.access_notes: The Farmers Market typically runs on Saturdays during the warmer months.

cards.title: Einstein Bros. Bagels
cards.subtitle: Newburg Road
cards.notes: Grab a quick breakfast sandwich or coffee at this convenient spot right on the edge of campus. It is a reliable morning stop for commuters and residential students alike.
cards.short_summary: A popular breakfast and coffee chain located on Newburg Road at the entrance to Bellarmine University.
cards.evidence_claim: Einstein Bros. Bagels is located at 2001 Newburg Rd, directly serving the Bellarmine University community.
cards.source_title: Discover Einstein Bros. Bagels In Louisville, KY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:30 AM - 8:00 PM, Friday until 5:00 PM. Closed weekends.

cards.title: Ramen House
cards.subtitle: Baxter Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy authentic ramen and bao buns at this highly-rated restaurant. Now located on South Spring Street, it remains a top recommendation for students exploring the Highlands area.
cards.short_summary: A popular Japanese restaurant known for its quality ramen, formerly in Mid-City Mall and now nearby in Irish Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramen House is a standout place worth a visit for Bellarmine students, specializing in ramen, buns, and dumplings.
cards.source_title: Five must-visit places in the Highlands - Bellarmine University
cards.access_notes: Recently moved from Mid-City Mall to 204 S. Spring St. Check social media for current hours.

cards.title: Beargrass Creek Path
cards.subtitle: Poplar Level Road Connection
cards.notes: Use the bridge behind Allen Hall to reach neighborhoods along Poplar Level Road. This path cuts a long walk down to 15 minutes, connecting campus to the broader Highlands area.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian bridge and path connecting Bellarmine's campus to surrounding neighborhoods over Beargrass Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: A new walking path and bridge connects Bellarmine's campus with neighborhoods along Poplar Level Road, providing safe passage over Beargrass Creek.
cards.source_title: New walking path and bridge on campus create access over Beargrass Creek
cards.access_notes: Open to pedestrians and bicyclists during daylight hours.
